description: Ministry of Justice Public Administration, Home Affairs, Provincial Council - Industrial Disputes between .1) Mr. Lalith Prasanna and Sri Lankan Broadcasting Corporation .2) Mr. C.J. Wijeweera and Mahaweli Authority of Sri Lanka .3) Mr. Asanka Sample and Sri Lanka Transport Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the appointment of an arbitrator under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle a specific labor dispute between employees and the Sri Lanka Broadcasting Corporation. It references specific legal provisions (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and contains an order made under statutory authority. While it mentions Dr. Harini Amarasuriya as Minister, this is in the context of exercising legal powers rather than detailing her portfolio responsibilities, making this a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
